scenes.heading: Avoiding the most common beginner mistakes

sents.d: Avoiding the most common beginner mistakes
Overtrading and revenge trading cause more damage than bad picks.

Some of the most common beginner mistakes aren't about picking the wrong asset — they're behavioral: overtrading out of boredom, 'revenge trading' to immediately win back a loss, and ignoring the cumulative effect of fees and spreads on frequent small trades.
Setting a maximum number of trades per day or week, and stepping away after a loss rather than immediately re-entering, are general habits many traders use to reduce these behavioral mistakes.
This is educational content only, not a recommendation to trade any particular asset or amount — individual circumstances vary.

take: Limit trades and step away after losses.
